title: Command Q Mod
description: Allows you to press Command + Drop key to drop a stack of items on macOS
body:
This mod allows macOS users to drop a stack of items while holding command, instead of just control. 1.21.11 changed this, but users who frequently switch versions may be annoyed about having to change their habits.

**This mod is NOT legal for speedrunning**. It is however allowed for use with [Draftout](https://modrinth.com/mod/draftout).

By default on macOS, command + Q quits the app, but this can be adjusted in System Settings:
The setting is under "Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts... > App Shortcuts", where you can add an app shortcut called "Quit java" (Case Sensitive) and set it to whatever you like (e.g. ctrl + option + Q)

This is what most players in 1.16 do to make the drop stack bind usable without rebinding drop to something other than Q, and it similarly allows this mod to be usable without rebinding the drop key.
